rationale.conceptual: The paper's method involves interacting components: Biot consolidation, a smeared crack model with stiffness reduction and anisotropic permeability, a coupling algorithm, and fracture energy control. Implementing this requires genuine understanding of the custom multi-part method and non-trivial mathematical derivations.
rationale.execution: The agent must implement a multi-step pipeline: mesh generation, solver for coupled nonlinear equations, integration of crack model, running three simulations, and post-processing to extract tip stresses and opening. This involves significant engineering and handoffs.
